desc: Implement input parsing and build adjacency list for tree with NK vertices.
Implement iterative DFS (order-then-reverse) computing each node's upward-extending unfinished path length (0 if subtree fully decomposed).
At each node, collect non-zero child return values, pair values summing to K-1 using frequency counts; each pair completes a path through the node.
After pairing, fail (No) if ≥2 unpaired values remain; if one remains with value a, return a+1 (or 0 if a+1==K); if none remain, return 1.
Handle edge cases: K=1 (always Yes), N=1 (tree must be a single path).
At root, print Yes iff final return value is 0; use fast I/O and iterative traversal to avoid recursion limits.
